integrity: Self-contained proof and diagnostic source files are included; the finite checks are not a substitute for the analytic proof. No external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact critical coefficients only for odd positive k and n=k+2, c>0. Zero counts on nonsingular intervals rely on a cited published theorem; no enumeration at singular values; an independent scientific audit has not been completed. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Chebyshev extrema give every critical coefficient in the gap-two harmonic-trinomial family
